description: "A Narrative of the Life and Adventures of Venture, a Native of Africa, but resident above sixty years in the United States of America, related by himself" is a autobiographical account written in the late 18th century. The book chronicles the life of Venture Smith, an African man who was enslaved and later gained his freedom in America.
